flow.name: cycle-scheduler-flow
flow.doc:description: Runs the confirmation cycle every minute; skips the round when a cycle is already running

try.doc:description: A running cycle is not an error: this round is skipped

flow-ref.name: cycle-run-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Takes the lock and processes the RECEIVED orders

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Confirmation cycle skipped: another one is running']

on-error-continue.doc:description: The cycle could not start (for example the ERP is down); the next round retries

flow.name: cycle-trigger-flow
flow.doc:description: Starts the confirmation cycle now in the background and answers 202; 409 when one is already running

choice.doc:description: Only one cycle at a time

raise-error.description: A confirmation cycle is already running

async.doc:description: The cycle runs in the background; the caller does not wait

try.doc:description: Errors of a background cycle are only logged

flow-ref.name: cycle-run-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Takes the lock and processes the RECEIVED orders

on-error-continue.doc:description: Logs a background cycle that could not run

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - Triggered confirmation cycle failed: ' ++ (error.description default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "STARTED", startedAt: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"} }

sub-flow.name: cycle-run-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Takes the lock (OS:KEY_ALREADY_EXISTS when taken), processes every RECEIVED order and always releases the lock

try.doc:description: The lock is released even when the cycle fails

logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the cycle

set-variable.doc:description: Orders to process in this round

try.doc:description: One order failing does not stop the cycle

flow-ref.name: cycle-order-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Prices, confirms and dispatches one order

on-error-continue.doc:description: Logs the order and goes on with the next one

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - Order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ' not completed: ' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' ' ++ (error.description default '')]
logger.doc:description: Logs the order that could not be completed
Logs the end of the cycle

on-error-propagate.doc:description: Releases the lock and lets the error go on

try.doc:description: Releasing must not hide the original error

on-error-continue.doc:description: Ignores a failed release (the entry expires)

sub-flow.name: cycle-order-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Prices, confirms and, with full stock, dispatches vars.order

http:request.doc:description: Stock, local price and providers of the order items (one batch call)

set-variable.doc:description: Price of each line without quoting (local or last price)
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import priceLines from modules::orders --- priceLines(vars.order.lines, vars.items) }]

foreach.doc:description: Only lines without local or last price are quoted live

set-variable.doc:description: Provider and product of the quote

choice.doc:description: A recently failed quote is not repeated: the line stays without price

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Quote ' ++ vars.backoffKey ++ ' skipped: it failed recently (order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ')']

try.doc:description: A provider that does not answer leaves the line without price

http:request.doc:description: Live quote from the preferred provider

on-error-continue.doc:description: No price for this line; back off this quote

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - No quote for item ' ++ vars.quoteLine.itemId ++ ' of order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ': ' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '')]

os:store.doc:description: Do not repeat this quote for a while

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import applyQuotes from modules::orders --- applyQuotes(vars.pricedLines, vars.quotes) }]

choice.doc:description: Without a price for every line the order stays RECEIVED

when.expression: #[output application/java --- do { import allPriced from modules::orders --- not allPriced(vars.pricedLines) }]

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ' stays RECEIVED: a line has no price']
logger.doc:description: The order waits for the next cycle

flow-ref.name: cycle-confirm-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Confirms and, with full stock, dispatches

sub-flow.name: cycle-confirm-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: PATCH to CONFIRMED; with full stock, outbound movements, dispatch note and order.registered

http:request.doc:description: Confirms the order with the prices; the ERP stores the last price of the provider
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- do { import confirmedLines from modules::orders --- { status: 'CONFIRMED', lines: confirmedLines(vars.pricedLines) } }]

choice.doc:description: 409: the order is no longer RECEIVED (someone else changed it)

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ' is no longer RECEIVED']

set-variable.doc:description: Confirmed order with prices and total

choice.doc:description: D8: only with full stock the dispatch note and the event go out

when.expression: #[output application/java --- do { import fullStock from modules::orders --- fullStock(vars.pricedLines, vars.items) }]

otherwise.doc:description: Stock shortage: CONFIRMED and the dispatch note waits

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ' CONFIRMED with stock shortage: the dispatch note waits']
logger.doc:description: The order appears in the exceptions inbox

sub-flow.name: cycle-dispatch-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Outbound movement per line, dispatch note to logistics and order.registered

http:request.doc:description: Outbound movement; the reference makes it happen once (D7)
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { itemId: payload.itemId, 'type': 'OUTBOUND', quantity: payload.quantity, reference: vars.order.orderId ++ '-out-' ++ payload.itemId, orderId: vars.order.orderId }]

http:request.doc:description: Name and delivery address for the dispatch note
Drops the dispatch note into the logistics pending folder
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { orderId: vars.order.orderId, customer: { name: vars.customer.name, address: vars.customer.address }, lines: vars.pricedLines map ((l) -> { sku: l.sku, quantity: l.quantity }) }]

amqp:publish.doc:description: order.registered to exchange orders.events (only the regular cycle publishes it, D8)

amqp:message.amqp:body: #[output application/json --- do { import orderRegistered from modules::orders --- orderRegistered(vars.confirmedOrder) }]

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Order ' ++ vars.order.orderId ++ ' CONFIRMED and dispatched; order.registered published']
